Q5738.reason: Under the UCC, a mixed goods/services contract is governed by the UCC unless services predominate, so Connie wins unless the service agreement predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at entry, and he entered only to enjoy the party, forming intent to steal afterward.

Q8324.reason: Chronic dopamine flooding causes the postsynaptic neuron to downregulate receptors, producing a hypodopaminergic craving state.
